notes.title: English version release on August 22, 2024.
notes.notes:
Bazutte VTuber -I want to go viral, even if it's just in a game!

English version release on August 22, 2024.

The UI and text are now available in English. You can select the language from the options in the top right corner.


The VTuber "Wataritama," who always enjoys morning ice cream, is launching a game on Steam!

Vertical streaming recommended!
You are the protagonist, captured live via OBS
A scenario full of unexpected challenges and improvisation
Playable in a short time
A wide variety of events
Multiple endings!
■ Big focus on the streamer! Expect unexpected challenges in this stream-oriented game!
"I want to go viral as a VTuber! Even if it's just a game!" is a social media simulation game.
You, the streamer, are the main character.
In the 10 days within the game, how many likes can you earn?

■ Vertical streaming recommended?
This game is best played with vertical streaming.
Since the character is you, stream yourself via OBS and enjoy playing live!

■ A variety of events and multiple endings are also highlights
The game features multiple endings.
Your actions over the 10 days will determine your fate.
There are also events linked to social media.
Expect unexpected challenges and surprises.
It’s time to show your skills as a streamer.

Platform: Steam
OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
Price: 2 USD

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Minor Adjustments
notes.notes:
h2]Error: Posts with Line Breaks Not Evaluated Correctly
Posts with line breaks were not being evaluated correctly.
As a result, when copied and used, the evaluation might change unexpectedly.

With this update, the issue of evaluations shifting for posts with line breaks has been resolved.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Addition of Test Players to Credits
The following item has been added to the credits:
テストプレイヤー：鏡宮ちるは 様

notes.title: About the game release time
notes.notes:
It looks like the game will be released at 6:00 AM PDT!

Thank you for looking forward to "バズってVTUBER ゲームでいいから万バズしたい！" This is the first time I'm releasing a game on Steam as an individual, so I'm quite nervous.

I've already received feedback from many of you before the release, with comments like "I want to play" and "Is streaming allowed?" Thank you so much.

Let's go with 6:00 AM PDT on May 20 (Mon)

Some of you have already set up streaming slots, which makes me very happy but also a bit anxious. I worry about "What if the game isn't released by the time they've scheduled their streams?"

I thought having a confirmed time would make everyone feel more at ease, so let's set the release time to 6:00 AM PDT.

I apologize to those who have scheduled their streams earlier than this time.

Thank you for your continued support of "バズってVTUBER ゲームでいいから万バズしたい！"

notes.title: Notice regarding game release
notes.notes:
*Firstly, this game only supports Japanese language.

"バズってVTuber-ゲームでいいから万バズしたい-" has been generating buzz through online news and my social media channels, and we sincerely appreciate it. This announcement contains two points.

We Recommend Reserving May 21st (Tuesday) for Streaming

We had previously announced the release date as May 20th (Monday) through online news and my social media channels.

However, due to my oversight that it is not on May 20th in Japanese time, we are currently unable to provide the exact time to everyone.
As this game is recommended for streaming, we assume there are those planning to stream it.
Therefore, we are informing you in advance.

If you want to schedule streaming reliably, we recommend reserving streaming plans for after May 21st (Tuesday).

Once the release time for May 20th (Monday) is confirmed, we will inform you again.

Currently, We're Making Final Adjustments to the UI

After uploading promotional videos to YouTube Shorts, it was discovered that certain text and screens are not visible on some viewing devices. We are currently adjusting the UI for the May 20th (Monday) release.
While pages with a lot of text will be designed to display properly on various devices, we are improving the UI for the following:

Event descriptions
Posted content
Number of likes
We will adjust so that viewers can see the parts they want to see.
We will handle this to ensure visibility on as many devices as possible.
In Conclusion

This being our first game release on Steam and also the game itself being our first attempt at vertical streaming, it is anticipated that issues may arise in presentation.
However, any problematic areas will be addressed through post-release updates to enhance the experience.

Despite such circumstances, we are excited to release the game and hope that everyone enjoys it.
We appreciate your continued support for "バズってVTuber-ゲームでいいから万バズしたい-".
